summary.en: The same squares sort into one band per category, top band first, so the longest band visibly wins; optionally a roulette frame locks on the protagonist, or one block is cut into shares.
summary.zh: 同一批方块按类别排成一档一档，从最上面一档起逐档落定，最长那档一眼胜出；可选轮盘框跳动后锁定主角，或把一整块切成份额。

fits: Which kinds, and which one matters: a category field over a counted set (up to 9 bands with the rest folded).
notFor: Overlapping groups (one item in several: use unit-axis); continuous measures.

intent.en: Which kind wins becomes visible as length: the same squares sort into bands and the longest band reads before its number does.
intent.zh: 哪一类最多变成看得见的长度：同一批方块排成带，最长的那条比数字先被读到。

content.en: 2–9 groups (name ≤ 14 chars / 6 字, count), a protagonist index, a title with *the protagonist* marked (≤ 44 / 16 字), a sub (≤ 40 / 16 字), an optional callout (≤ 26 / 14 字).
content.zh: 2–9 组（名称 ≤ 14 字符 / 6 字，带数量），主角序号，标题里用 *星号* 标主角（≤ 44 / 16 字），副标题（≤ 40 / 16 字），可选标注（≤ 26 / 14 字）。

fits.zh: 哪几类、哪一类要紧：计数集合上的一个分类字段（最多 9 条带，其余并成一条）。

notFor.zh: 互相重叠的分组（一件属于多组：用 unit-axis）；连续量。

en: The roulette needs a protagonist that is not the top band, or the lock is no surprise.
Fold anything past nine bands into one 'other' band.
zh: 轮盘要锁的主角最好不是第一条，否则锁定没有意外。
超过 9 条的并成一条“其他”。

overlaps.note: its clusters and columns stand for several units a dot; here bands of one square per item

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
